rule: agent-action-capsule spec/standard-history-v0.md §11.2 "Agreed no later than witnessed" (#696): agreed_at MUST NOT be later than the deal's first witnessed time by more than 300 seconds

cases.name: agreed-before
cases.why: agreed an hour before the first witness registration

cases.name: skew-at-allowance
cases.why: the holder's clock 300 seconds ahead of the witness's: inside the allowance

cases.name: skew-past-allowance
cases.why: 301 seconds after the first witnessed time: not well formed

cases.name: moved-a-month-later
cases.why: agreed_at a month after a witness timed the agreement, as a holder moving a deal into a later window would write it

cases.name: offset-time
cases.why: agreed_at written with an offset compares as the same instant: 13:04:00+01:00 is 12:04:00Z, inside the allowance

cases.name: malformed
cases.why: agreed_at that is no RFC 3339 time is refused, never read as earlier
